Chan School of Public Health Other Positions Associate of the Department of South Asia Institute South Asia Institute -Other, Harvard Faculty of Arts and Sciences Dr. Saravanan Thangarajan is a Harvard-trained clinician-scientist and global health strategist serving as Visiting Scientist and Academic Appointment at Ariadne Labs, Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health and Brigham and Women's Hospital. His research unites climate-related maternal mental health, oral-systemic and oncologic care, and AI-enabled system design to strengthen equitable and resilient models of health delivery.
